name: Globale Tessile Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2017, Globale Tessile 
Ltd manufactures and sells Traditional 
Textiles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GTL is in the business of manufacturing, wholesaling, retailing and exporting of Beaded George Fabric, Ladies Kaftans, Net Blouse Fabric and Pearl Embroidered Net Fabric. Company manufactures the offered products in various sizes suiting to the requirements of its clients
